rationale: The single reply lands squarely on the hidden truth (biofilm from low-temp washes, softener, closed door) and gives the right fixes: clean seal/drawer/filter, run Drum Clean, leave door ajar, cut softener, hot washes. It asked no questions, so it never confirmed the musty-vs-drain distinction or checked seal/drawer state, and it omitted the unplug-before-filter step, though it did warn about water spill and bleach/vinegar mixing. Seal replacement was mentioned only conditionally and engineer referral only as a last resort, which is proportionate. A UK homeowner would be well served, if slightly over-loaded for a first message.
